mapper.sql: a.id as id ,a.qiye_id as qiyeId ,a.zhaopin_gangwei_name as zhaopinGangweiName ,a.zhaopin_leixing as zhaopinLeixing ,a.xinzi_fanwei as xinziFanwei ,a.gongzuo_dizhi as gongzuoDizhi ,a.gongzuo_yaoqiu as gongzuoYaoqiu ,a.yizhao_renshu as yizhaoRenshu ,a.zhaopin_renshu as zhaopinRenshu ,a.create_time as createTime
mapper.select:
SELECT
,qiye.qiye_name as qiyeName ,qiye.qiye_bianhao as qiyeBianhao ,qiye.qiye_address as qiyeAddress ,qiye.qiye_phone as qiyePhone ,qiye.qiye_email as qiyeEmail ,qiye.qiye_types as qiyeTypes FROM zhaopin_gangwei a left JOIN qiye qiye ON a.qiye_id = qiye.id
and a.id in
#{item}
and a.qiye_id = #{params.qiyeId}
and a.zhaopin_gangwei_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.zhaopinGangweiName},'%')
and a.zhaopin_leixing like CONCAT('%',#{params.zhaopinLeixing},'%')
and a.xinzi_fanwei like CONCAT('%',#{params.xinziFanwei},'%')
and a.gongzuo_dizhi like CONCAT('%',#{params.gongzuoDizhi},'%')
and qiye.qiye_name like CONCAT('%',#{params.qiyeName},'%')
and IFNULL(a.yizhao_renshu, 0) < IFNULL(a.zhaopin_renshu, 0)
order by a.${params.orderBy} desc
